heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service category.

items.question: What UI/UX design services do you offer?
items.answer: We offer UX research, wireframing, prototyping, mobile and web UI design, design systems, usability testing, UX audits and redesigns.

items.question: What is the difference between UI and UX design?
items.answer: UX design is about how a product works and feels — flows, structure and usability. UI design is how it looks — colour, typography, layout and visual detail. A great product needs both.

items.question: How long does a design project take?
items.answer: A website or small app design typically takes 3 to 6 weeks, while larger products and design systems take 2 to 4 months depending on scope.

items.question: Do you work with our development team?
items.answer: Yes. We deliver developer-ready files and can stay involved during the build to make sure the final product matches the design.

items.question: Can you redesign an existing product?
items.answer: Yes. We start with a UX audit to identify problems, then redesign the key flows and screens that will make the biggest difference.
